_comment: Luke's fitness plan as structured data. Edit this file to change the plan. send_daily.py reads it to build each morning's email. Phase 1 is a 10-day rolling cycle starting on phase1_start_date.

phase1_days.warm_up: 5-8 min: dynamic mobility, light cardio, hip activation
phase1_days.short_version: Drop to 2 sets per exercise. Skip Bulgarian split squats.
phase1_days.purpose: First lift of the rolling 10-day template. Squat as main work, RDL as the secondary hinge. Pallof press transfers to single-leg running stance and squash strokes.

phase1_days.extras: Optional squash in the evening (counts as your tempo session for the week).

phase1_days.warm_up: 5-8 min: dynamic mobility, light cardio, shoulder activation
phase1_days.short_version: Bench + OHP only, 3 sets each, skip accessories.
phase1_days.purpose: Upper push day. Bench is the priority for the 100kg trajectory — focus on form, RIR 3, no grinders. OHP secondary.

phase1_days.extras: No squash today. If yesterday's was hard, replace this with a walk.

phase1_days.details: Default: rest. Optional 20-min mobility flow: 90/90 hip switches (10/side), couch stretch (60s/side), deep squat hold (60s), cat-cow (10 reps), thoracic rotations (10/side), calf stretch (60s/side).

phase1_days.extras: Goal: time on feet, not speed. Optional last 2 km at marathon-pace feel (4:50/km) if you're feeling springy — easy to skip the MP segment.
phase1_days.short_version: 8-10 km easy. Don't push if you're not feeling it.

phase1_days.details: Walk with partner or dog. Otherwise full rest.

phase1_days.warm_up: 5-8 min: dynamic mobility, light cardio, full-body activation
phase1_days.short_version: Pull-ups + DB bench + single-leg RDL only. 3 sets each.
phase1_days.purpose: Lighter full-body session. Pull-ups are the key lift here — strict, controlled. Woodchopper trains rotational core for racket sports.

phase1_days.warm_up: 5-8 min: dynamic mobility, light cardio, hip and hamstring activation
phase1_days.short_version: RDL + hip thrust only, 3 sets each. Skip front squats.
phase1_days.purpose: Hinge-dominant lower day. RDL is the key lift — directly supports running propulsion. Side plank trains frontal-plane stability for single-leg stance.

hard_rules_phase1: If labour starts, stop. No 'one last session.'
Easy means easy — HR <150 on easy runs.
Sleep is the override: <6h = drop to a walk or skip.

phase2_menu.preamble: No calendar, no expectations. Open this on a Monday morning and remember: the marathon is months away. Recovery is the work right now.

grid.wrecked: Skip or 5-min walk in fresh air.

grid.tired: 20-min walk + bodyweight circuit OR easy bike spin.
grid.decent: 20-min easy run/walk (after wk 3) OR 25-min light gym.

grid.wrecked: Skip the workout. Use it for a nap.
grid.decent: 30-40 min easy run (after wk 3) OR full A1/A2 strength at 60% volume.

readiness_for_phase3: Can comfortably run 30-40 min continuously at easy pace (5:45-6:00/km), HR <150.
Can do two strength sessions in a week without lingering soreness.
Sleep is averaging 5+ hours, even if broken.
Mentally, you actually want to start training again.

phase3._comment: Phase 3 plan to be written when Luke reaches ~6 weeks postpartum readiness. Will be a 17-week structured marathon build through 22 Nov 2026.
